modeBoundary: Classic-safe compatibility infrastructure; unproven Classic constants remain configurable and provenance-tagged

integrations.movement: returns deterministic follower movement requests without bypassing movement validation
integrations.combat: does not calculate damage, targeting, or shared rewards
integrations.economy: does not calculate loot or currency distribution
integrations.quests: does not calculate shared quest credit
integrations.sessions: accepts connected/disconnected state and preserves policy boundary

safeFallbacks: unknown party membership rejects the operation
expired invitations are removed and rejected
followers move only when connected, opted in, and co-located with the leader
offline members do not receive party chat delivery
